programme.title: Dhund
programme.desc: On a lonely road a man (Sanjay Khan) has a car accident and tries to find help at a nearby house. He enters to discover a dead corpse and he sees a beautiful girl with a pistol in her hand.

programme.title: Deewana Main Deewana
programme.desc: Basant always gets what he wants and when he falls in love with Priya at first sight, he wants her to be his. Later, he impersonates his friend Vasant, who had saved her life before, to win her over.

programme.title: Dil Tera Aashiq
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Soniya in the dancing school where both are dance instructors. Thakur who is a confirmed bachelor is also drawn towards Savitri Devi; who is being impersonated by Soniya.

programme.title: Safar
programme.desc: A pair of lovers are cruelly separated by destiny when the boy is diagnosed with terminal cancer. On his insistence, the girl settles down with another man, but he turns out to be a jealous husband.

programme.title: Dil Tujhko Diya
programme.desc: Two step brothers are separated after their father dies and they mother goes to jail. Years later they come together but the elder brother detests the younger and hates the mother for killing his dad.

programme.title: Khamoshi
programme.desc: Radha is a nurse at a hospital treating patients. Her work involves providing patients with unconditional love and care and in doing so she finds herself falling in love with them.

programme.title: Ajanabee
programme.desc: Middle-classed Rohit (Rajesh Khanna) falls in love with rich Reshmi (Zeenat Aman) and marries her. But fate has other plans and he gets arrested for the murder which he never committed.

programme.title: Disco Dancer
programme.desc: Anil's mother is falsely accused of theft and jailed. Anil swears to set this right one day. Years later, he becomes a big star and restores his mother's honour. Now his fame earns him more enemies.

programme.title: Raaz
programme.desc: Sanjana and Aditya go to Ooty for a holiday to save their unsteady marriage. However, Sanjana is haunted by a spirit who reveals some dark secrets about Aditya and his past.

programme.title: Chacha Bhatija
programme.desc: The story is about how an uncle and his nephew bring together a separated couple with their tricks.

programme.title: Khanjar
programme.desc: Ajay has a past and does not know that he will be swept into a web of lies, deceit, and murder where a killer is killing local people on the 13th of every month. Watch how the past reveals.

programme.title: Kasauti
programme.desc: Amit, a young taxi driver saves Sapna from a lusty smuggler and falls in love with her. His troubles increase when she gets framed for robbery and is arrested.

programme.title: Sawan Ki Ghata
programme.desc: A man arranges his daughter's marriage to prevent her from marrying the man who truly loves her.

programme.title: Love Love Love

programme.title: Jawani Zindabad
